intro: The Defias Tower Key is an item stolen from the monstrous sentries guarding Klaven's Tower in Westfall. Carried by the mutated drones defending the site, it represents vital proof of the Defias Brotherhood's dangerous operations and is sought by Stormwind intelligence operatives.

sections.t: A Prize from the Twisted Guard
p: Klaven's Tower along the Westfall coastline has long served as a stronghold for the Defias Brotherhood, but recent shipments out of Duskwood brought far more terrifying sentries to its perimeter. Among the guards are malformed Defias drones—undead, spike-ridden abominations. To pierce the defenses and prove the perimeter breached, SI:7 operatives stake out the grounds and mandate that field agents pick the pockets of these grotesque sentinels rather than engage them head-on. The key serves as clear evidence that an infiltrator penetrated the perimeter without sounding an alarm.
